title: PinchManifest
description: Root configuration manifest for a Pinch project (`pinch.yaml`).

auto_restart.description: Whether processes restart automatically if they exit or crash (default: `true`).

auto_start.description: Whether processes start automatically upon launching the supervisor (default: `true`).

docker_networks.description: Custom Docker bridge networks managed and initialized by Pinch.

grace_period.description: Delay in milliseconds before automatically restarting a process after an exit (default: `3000`).

layout.description: Progressive edge-carving layout rules defining how process panes are arranged.

logs_max_size.description: Maximum number of log lines to retain in memory per process pane.

processes.description: List of supervised processes, containers, and background services to execute.

project.description: Core project metadata, governance attributes, and architecture classification.

schema_version.description: Explicit schema version for manifest compatibility (must be 1).

shell.description: If true, executes shorthand command strings using `bash -c` globally (default: `false`).

vars.description: Custom configuration variables available for string expansion (e.g., `{{var_name}}`).

watch_settle_time_ms.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds when watching files for auto-restarting (default: `800`).

AdsLoggingStatus.description: Status of immutable AdS access log generation and retention.

oneOf.description: Immutable access logs recorded and retained for at least 6 months (standard).
Immutable access logs recorded and retained for at least 12 months (banking/health).
Logging is enabled but not tamper-proof or integrity-verified.
Access logging is delegated to external cloud/infrastructure provider.
Logging is not implemented or disabled.

AdsManifest.description: Italian Garante Privacy 'Amministratore di Sistema' (AdS) compliance specification.

latest_audit.description: Date when the last annual verification/audit was completed (ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DD).

logging.description: Immutable access log retention status (login/logout/failed attempts).

nominated.description: Whether formal designation letters ('Lettera di Nomina') have been executed.

responsibility.description: Responsibility boundary for System Administration (AdS) operations.

oneOf.description: Our organization directly manages the system/infrastructure as AdS.
An external Managed Service Provider (MSP) / Vendor holds AdS duties.
The client / customer holds AdS responsibility for their own environment.
No AdS scope applies (no personal data processed or no privileged access).

AiActClass.description: EU AI Act risk classification tier.

oneOf.description: High-Risk AI System (biometrics, critical infrastructure, employment, credit scoring).
General Purpose AI (GPAI) model or foundation model integration.
Limited Risk AI System (requires transparency disclosures, e.g., chatbots/AI assistants).
Minimal or no risk AI system.
Not an AI system; EU AI Act not applicable.

AuthType.description: Primary authentication mechanism for ingress requests.

oneOf.description: Identity provider abstraction.
OpenID Connect (OIDC) identity authentication layer.
Generic OAuth 2.0 framework.
Generic SAML 2.0 Web SSO.
API Key header or query parameter validation.
Stateless JSON Web Token (JWT) signature validation.
Mutual TLS client certificate authentication.
HMAC request signature validation (e.g., webhooks).
Stateful cookie or HTTP session authentication.
Custom bearer token or generic token authentication.
HTTP Basic authentication (legacy/internal).
Custom HTML form authentication.
Explicitly public endpoint accepting unauthenticated requests (e.g., public API or landing page).
Authentication is not applicable (e.g., offline CLI utility, library, or background job).

ComplianceManifest.description:
Regulatory compliance and cybersecurity resilience specifications.

### Framework Applicability Guide
* **`dora`:** EU financial sector & ICT third-party providers to finance.
* **`cra`:** Software products with digital elements sold/distributed in the EU.
* **`nis2`:** Critical/important non-financial infrastructure (energy, health, SaaS, MSPs).
* **`aiact`:** Systems integrating AI/ML models, LLMs, or automated inference.
* **`gdpr`:** Any project processing, storing, or transmitting EU/EEA personal data.
* **`ads`:** Italian Garante Privacy governance for privileged IT/database administrators.

ads.description:
Italian Garante Privacy 'Amministratore di Sistema' (AdS) compliance block.

### Applicability Scope
Mandatory under **Italian data protection regulations (Provvedimento Garante Privacy 2008/2009)** whenever technical personnel or automated processes hold **privileged administrative access** over systems or databases containing personal data.

ai_act.description:
EU AI Act risk classification tier.

### Applicability Scope
Applies whenever the project develops, deploys, or integrates **AI/ML models, LLMs, foundation models, or automated decision-making/inference engines**.

cra.description:
EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) product classification tier.

### Applicability Scope
Applies to any **software product with digital elements** distributed, commercialized, or deployed in the EU marketplace (including standalone software, firmware, and SaaS runtimes).

dora.description:
DORA (Digital Operational Resilience Act) criticality tag.

### Applicability Scope
Applies if the project operates within or provides ICT services to **EU financial institutions** (banks, insurance companies, investment firms, payment processors, or crypto-asset service providers).

gdpr.description:
GDPR data protection role and data residency boundaries.

### Applicability Scope
Applies to **any project that processes, stores, transmits, or logs personal data** (PII/SPI) belonging to individuals located in the EU/EEA.

nis2.description:
EU NIS2 Directive criticality classification.

### Applicability Scope
Applies if the project supports **critical or important non-financial infrastructure** across the EU (such as energy, healthcare, transport, water, digital providers, SaaS marketplaces, or managed ICT services).

CraClass.description: EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) product classification tier for cybersecurity compliance.

oneOf.description: Default category: Standard software product with digital elements.
Important Class I: Identity management, password managers, VPNs, network monitors.
Important Class II: Hypervisors, container runtimes, firewalls, IDS/IPS.
Critical: Smartcards, hardware security modules, and core cryptographic hardware/software.

DataResidency.description:
Geographic data storage and processing boundary for compliance.

Storing or transferring personal data across any EEA country (e.g., hosting servers in Norway or Iceland instead of Germany)
meets standard EU data residency requirements without requiring special cross-border transfer safeguards like Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs)

oneOf.description: Data is stored and processed strictly within European Union member states.
Data is stored and processed within the European Economic Area (EU + Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway).
Data is stored or processed globally across international regions.

DockerNetworkConfig.description: Configuration for creating a Docker bridge network.

anyOf.description: CIDR subnet string for the bridge network (e.g., `"172.18.23.0/24"`).
Explicit network configuration specifying subnet CIDR and custom Docker creation arguments.

args.description: Custom CLI arguments passed to `docker network create`.

subnet.description: CIDR subnet string for the bridge network.

oneOf.description: Managed directly by our infrastructure / DNS / CDN rules.
Managed externally by a client, partner, or third party.

DoraCriticality.description: DORA (Digital Operational Resilience Act) operational criticality tag.

oneOf.description: Supports a Critical or Important Function (CIF) subject to strict RTO/RPO SLAs.
Non-critical ICT supporting service or internal developer utility.

domains.description: Map of domain names to their management origin (managed vs external).

ingress.description: Network ingress reachability for this specific environment.

management.description: Network management reachability for this specific environment.

oneOf.description: Local developer workstation or local machine loopback.
Shared cloud or hosted development environment.
Short-lived, dynamic per-PR or per-branch preview environment.
Automated CI/CD integration and unit testing environment.
Dedicated Quality Assurance and manual regression environment.
User Acceptance Testing environment for business stakeholder validation.
Isolated sandbox playground for external integrations and experimentation.
Near-exact production replica environment running parallel cutover validation (ambiente di parallelo).
Pre-production mirror environment for final release candidate acceptance.
Sales demo, customer sandbox, or product preview environment.
Dedicated load testing and performance benchmarking environment.
Dark-launch or traffic-mirrored environment receiving real-time production traffic passively.
Live customer-facing production environment.
Disaster recovery, warm standby, or secondary failover region.

ExposureType.description: Network ingress reachability for the project.

oneOf.description: Reachable only on localhost or local machine process loopback.
Reachable only inside the private corporate VPN, VPC, or internal service mesh.
Reachable from the internet but restricted by IP allowlisting or CIDR controls.
Reachable only through a Privileged Access Management (PAM) broker or session proxy (e.g., CyberArk, Teleport).
Publicly reachable from the internet.
No incoming network traffic (e.g., background worker or CLI tool).

GdprManifest.description: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) architectural specification.

data_residency.description: Whether personal data is processed or stored strictly within the EU/EEA.

role.description: Our organization's legal role regarding personal data in this project.

oneOf.description: Data Controller (Titolare del trattamento) - determines purposes and means of processing.
Data Processor (Responsabile del trattamento) - processes data on behalf of a Controller.
Sub-processor (Sub-responsabile) - third-party processor engaged by a Processor.
No personal data processed.

LayoutBlock.description: A progressive edge-carving block ruleset for arranging terminal panes.

direction.description: Split orientation for sub-panes inside an edge-carved block.

edge.description: Side of the remaining terminal space to carve from (`top`, `bottom`, `left`, `right`).

name.description: Target process name to place inside this block (or `"Combined Logs"`).

size_percentage.description: Percentage of currently available space to allocate (0 to 100).

splits.description: Sub-panes to arrange within this carved edge block.

unassigned.description: If true, automatically places all unassigned process panes inside this block.

LayoutEdge.description: Target edge of the terminal space to carve from.

oneOf.description: Carve from the top edge.
Carve from the bottom edge.
Carve from the left edge.
Carve from the right edge.

LayoutSplit.description: A sub-pane division within an edge-carved layout block.

name.description: Target process name to place inside this split (or `"combined-logs"`).

size.description: Percentage of space within the parent block to allocate (0 to 100).

unassigned.description: If true, automatically places all unassigned process panes inside this split.

LifecycleType.description: Operational maintenance status of the repository.

oneOf.description: Actively developed and supported in production.
Scheduled for decommissioning; do not add new dependencies.
In production but receiving only critical bug/security fixes.
Experimental proof-of-concept; no production SLA.

Nis2Category.description: EU NIS2 Directive classification tier for cybersecurity resilience.

oneOf.description: Essential Entity (Soggetti Essenziali): Energy, transport, banking, health, digital infrastructure.
Important Entity (Soggetti Importanti): Postal, waste, chemicals, food, digital providers (SaaS/marketplaces).
Not in scope of NIS2 requirements.

PaneMode.description: Display rendering mode for a process pane.

oneOf.description: Standard streaming log tailer with wrap and truncation controls.
Allocates a PTY for interactive terminal applications (`top`, `vim`, `htop`).

ProcessManifest.description: Configuration for an individual supervised process or container.

auto_restart.description: Override global auto-restart default for this specific process.

auto_start.description: Override global auto-start default for this specific process.

cwd.description: Working directory for process execution (supports variable expansion like `{{pwd}}`).

grace_period.description: Override global grace period delay in milliseconds for this specific process.

link.description: Optional web URL or link associated with this process (clickable in the TUI header).

mode.description: Display mode for the process output in the TUI dashboard (`log` or `tui`).

run.description: Execution definition specifying how the command or container is spawned.

title.description: Display name of the process pane in the TUI dashboard. (defaults to name)

watch.description: List of file or directory paths that trigger an automatic restart when modified.

watch_settle_time_ms.description: Process-specific debounce delay in milliseconds for file watching.

ProjectManifest.description: High-level project identification, governance, and architecture classification.

compliance.description: Regulatory compliance and resilience framework mappings.

tier.description: Operational service tier dictating on-call priority and internal incident response targets.

ProjectType.description: Primary architectural role of the project.

oneOf.description: Shared code dependency imported by other projects.
Long-running server, API, or backend daemon.
CLI utility or internal developer tool.
Short-lived batch process, cron, or CI/CD script.

RunKind.description: Explicit runtime environment type for a supervised process.

oneOf.description: Spawns a standard local OS process.

bash.description: Whether to wrap the command string in `bash -c` (default: `false`).

oneOf.description: Spawns a managed Docker container using `docker run --rm`.

args.description: Arguments passed to the container's entrypoint.

image.description: The Docker image reference to run.

oneOf.description: Spawns a local host binary attached inside a Docker bridge network namespace (`docker-intrude`).

bash.description: Whether to wrap the command string in `bash -c` (default: `false`).

cmd.description: Host command string to execute within the target network namespace.

ip.description: Static IP address assigned to the namespace container on the target bridge subnet.

network.description: Target Docker network name (optional if exactly one network is defined in `docker_networks`).

RunManifest.description: How the process command is specified in YAML.

anyOf.description: Simple shell command string executed as a local OS process.
Explicit execution configuration specifying process type (`process`, `docker`, or `docker-intrude`).

Sensitivity.description:
Sensitive data classifications handled by the service.

### Data Classification Hierarchy
* **Public** → **Internal** → **Confidential** → **Restricted**

### Regulatory Standards Covered
* **GDPR / CCPA / BIPA:** `Pii`, `Spi`, `Biometric`
* **PCI-DSS:** `Pci`
* **SOX:** `Financial`
* **HIPAA:** `Phi`

oneOf.description: Non-sensitive data safe for public distribution.
Standard internal business data.
Restricted company intellectual property or business trade secrets.
Maximum security assets requiring strict isolation (e.g., root credentials, master keys).
Personally Identifiable Information (names, emails, addresses).
Sensitive PII / Special Category Data (genetics, political/religious beliefs under GDPR Art. 9).
Biometric identification data (fingerprints, facial recognition, voice signatures).
Payment Card Industry data (credit cards, billing details, PANs).
Non-PCI financial records (SOX audit trails, payroll, company accounting, bank accounts).
Protected Health Information (medical records, insurance claims, health data).

ServiceTier.description: Operational service tier dictating on-call priority and internal incident response targets.

oneOf.description: Tier 1: Critical production path (24/7 on-call, immediate response SLO).
Tier 2: Core supporting functionality (business hours support, rapid degradation fallback).
Tier 3: Internal developer tools, async batch jobs, or non-critical support utilities.
Tier 4: Experimental prototypes, sandbox playgrounds, or best-effort utilities.
